summary.zh: Gemini 的驱动声明补上 nudge-install-hooks（hooks 随扩展交付，与支持矩阵一致），并新增守卫：矩阵标不支持或不适用的功能必须由驱动声明，驱动声明的不支持项矩阵里也要有。
summary.en: The Gemini driver now declares nudge-install-hooks (hooks ship inside the extension, as the support matrix says), and a new guard reconciles the matrix with the drivers in both directions.
